title: Equivalent fractions general rule
text: Recall that $$\frac{a}{b}=\frac{c}{d}$$ if and only if $$ad=bc$$

title: Equivalence decoded
text: Cross-multiplying, we find that $$\frac{x^3+3}{2x^2+1}=\frac{x+5}{8}$$ is equivalent to $$8\left(x^3+3\right)=\left(x+5\right) \left(2x^2+1\right)$$, assuming the denominators are never zero, which they are not here.
